summary: Backend tests for the guest query path: guest_queries row written, zero authenticated-side writes
description: Depends on the guest query path. Integration tests: (a) first guest query returns a full streamed answer with citations AND writes exactly one queries row with user_id IS NULL, session_id IS NULL, tier_used='guest', cost_usd + tokens + ip_name populated; (b) second query on same guest token refused (one-shot); (c) guest:<ip> throttle rejects after N across rotated tokens; (d) assert NO users row, NO sessions row, and NO user_budgets reservation for a guest call; (e) signed-cookie tamper rejected; (f) guest rows are excluded from the per-tier spend aggregates (tier_used='guest' not counted as free/pro). Mirror existing style in src/__tests__.

resolution.note: 6 tests: persist shape + one-shot + IP backstop + no-authed-writes + tamper/empty
